import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "-----011000010111000001101001\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"item_template_reference\"\r\n\r\n{\"item_id\":54,\"type\":\"attachment\",\"payload\":{\"attachment\":\"string\",\"image_id\":0,\"form_id\":0,\"folder_id\":0,\"file_version_id\":0,\"drawing_revision_id\":0,\"document_management_document_revision_id\":0}}\r\n-----011000010111000001101001--\r\n"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "multipart/form-data; boundary=---011000010111000001101001"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/inspection_templates/%7Binspection_template_id%7D/item_references", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
